title: Let the input box fill the remaining space
goal: In the collection search bar, let the input box occupy the remaining width and the search button maintains a fixed width.
summary: Flexbox first considers the initial size of each item, and then presses flex-grow to allocate the remaining space. When an item's value is 0, it is not allocated extra space.
tasks: Set the flex-grow of the keyword input box #book-query to 1.
makes the input box widen as the window becomes wider, the query button maintains 80px, and the original 12px spacing continues to take effect.
hint: Write flex-grow on the item to be widened. Note that the query button already has a fixed size setting.

example.note: course entry, the course name occupies the extra width, and only the number of class hours is marked on the right.
